description: Jump to the definition of a symbol at a specific location in a file via LSP. Returns the file path and position where the symbol is defined. Useful for navigating to type declarations, function implementations, or variable assignments across the codebase.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the source file

language_id.description: Language identifier (e.g. go\, typescript\, python). Optional; auto-detected from file extension

position_pattern.description: Alternative to line/column: use @@pattern@@ syntax to match text near the target position

name: go_to_definition
